name: Genuine Service - Fortis Hospital Admission Aadhaar Desk (English)

caller_script.text: Good afternoon, this is Priya calling from Fortis Hospital admission desk regarding Mrs. Sharma's scheduled knee consultation tomorrow.
For the cashless health insurance desk and hospital registration, please remember to bring a photocopy of the patient's Aadhaar card and doctor prescription.
You do not need to send anything over the phone. Just show the document at reception desk number 4 on the first floor. Have a good day.
